content.thinking:
The layered generator can create edges with v >= n? members built with idx up to inner+1 where inner ≤ (n-2)*4 — wait I set `inner = rng.randint(0, min(n-2, layers-2)*4)`, so idx can exceed n-1: e.g., n=5, layers=6 → min(3,4)*4 = 12 inner nodes but n-1=4. Bug: inner must be ≤ n-2 exactly, and I want to distribute exactly n-2 inner nodes among middle layers.

Fix: inner_total = n-2, distribute among (layers-2) middle layers as nonneg parts.
